snapshot_scope: Public demo catalogue for open spatial crop and environmental reference data. No FAOSTAT data rows or national time-series output are included in this public catalogue.

datasets.name: IFPRI MAPSPAM 2020 v2r2
datasets.attribution: IFPRI, Global Spatially-Disaggregated Crop Production Statistics (MAPSPAM) 2020 v2r2; CC BY-SA 4.0.
caveats: 2020 is a single reference year, not an annual time series, current-year measurement or future forecast.
Grid cells are approximately 9.3 km at the equator; this is not field-scale data.
Yield is a harvested-area-weighted estimate and must not be summed.
ADM0, ADM1 and ADM2 are separate hierarchy summaries and must not be added as if they were mutually exclusive areas.
Missing raster coverage is NULL, not zero.

datasets.name: CROPGRIDS v1.08
datasets.caveat: Source catalogue only; these layers are not part of the public prediction pipeline.

boundaries.source: geoBoundaries gbOpen with World Bank Official Boundaries fallback where needed
boundaries.availability_note: The country-specific static boundary catalogue is checked in GitHub Actions. Higher ADM levels are not fabricated; their availability depends on the country source.

automatic_official_series.note: Production divided by sown area; not a district or field measurement.

models.status: Research-only. MAPSPAM 2020 is one reference year and cannot, by itself, train a temporal yield forecast. Other area/crop forecasts require the matching observed yield history.

environmental_sources.scope: ERA5-Land historical daily weather at the selected polygon representative point
Current weather and seven-day point forecast in the selected area workflow
Copernicus Data Space STAC scene search by polygon, date range and cloud threshold; NDVI pixels are not computed
Dataset identified; Earthdata authentication and raster zonal adapter still required

public_static_subsets.name: Uzbekistan MAPSPAM 2020 district/province reference
caveats: Historical gridded estimate, not field measurement or future forecast.
ADM1 and ADM2 have different boundary vintages.

global_mapspam_static_export.format: one gzip-compressed JSON file per country plus manifest.json
global_mapspam_static_export.database_access: local read-only query against the maintainer's PostgreSQL reference archive
global_mapspam_static_export.note: The exporter creates a separate gzip JSON package and manifest from the maintainer's local PostgreSQL reference archive. Packages become public only after local validation and commit; FAOSTAT rows, user uploads, credentials and raw raster pixels are not exported.
